title: Terrorists could exploit AI weapons — Nigeria warns
description: Nigeria has called for legally binding international rules governing autonomous weapons, warning that increasingly affordable military technologies could fall into the hands of terrorists. The Federal Government made the appeal at the sixth plenary meeting of the United Nations General Assembly’s First Committee, responsible for disarmament and international security. title: KOSPI Rebounds After Seven-Day Slide as AI Doubts Linger
description: The KOSPI rebounded 2.05% after a seven-session slide that cut the index about 21%, as AI funding and Chinese memory concerns weighed on stocks.
